download_url_content: download the binary content from a URL with automatic retry on connection errors
open_remote_file: open a remote file from a URL as a text iterable with optional disk caching
cached_file_download: download a file from a URL to a local cache directory with progress bar
cached_file_download_unzip: download and unzip a zip archive from a URL to a local cache directory
cached_file_redownload: force redownload a cached file by removing the existing copy and fetching fresh content
